name: EPIC 212358960
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 7.2 solar radii and 0.98 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212358960 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.240115 (16th-84th percentiles 6.971814-7.5206), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,012 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.98 solar masses and 7.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,008 K at its surface.
